title: Dokimos evidence reuse request
description: Input to `dokimos evidence plan`: the tests to judge with their declared test-to-input mappings and freshness policies, and recorded provenance of earlier runs. Unknown and duplicate members are refused.

Revision.description: The commit being verified. --root must be a checkout at exactly this commit with no tracked modifications.

ChangedPaths.description: Optional. Paths changed since the evidence being considered (for example `git diff --name-only BASE REVISION`). Can only add tests to the run set.

GlobalInputs.description: Optional. Paths that are inputs of every mapped test (lock files, build props, CI workflow).

IgnoredPaths.description: Optional. Paths declared to affect no test. A changed path matched by no test, no global input and no ignored pattern runs every test.

Category.description: Optional (added after Dokimos 0.8.0); absent means functional. Security and independent-acceptance evidence is never reused (REUSE.SECURITY_NEVER_REUSED, REUSE.ACCEPTANCE_NEVER_REUSED).

Inputs.description: Optional. Absent means the mapping is unknown and the test always runs.

TestContract.description: Repository path of the test's contract (its specification or definition file).

Dependencies.description: Dependency name to version or identity digest.

ToolVersion.description: Verification tool name and version, for example `dotnet-sdk 10.0.402; playwright 1.48.2`.

provenance.description: dokimos.evidence-provenance/1, the record a host publishes after running a planned test, passing or failing (`dokimos evidence record`; stored under provenance/ in the evidence store). Members after Outcome are optional at intake so a record lacking them is refused for reuse (REUSE.PROVENANCE_MISSING) rather than dropped; the store accepts only complete, self-consistent records.
